name: bulwark
description: Bulwark: a request shield for self-hosted gateways. An attack engine with 21 categories and 44 CVE exploits that sees through encodings, behaviour scoring, blocklists and bans on every request in microseconds; full request logs, waves, pattern graphs, an IP Inspector and vendor reporting in its own dashboard; email alerts through the selfmail addon.
author: Alexd Aero

scripts.check: for f in core/*.mjs sensor/*.mjs server.mjs public/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in bin/bulwark forge/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
